page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m8.4xlarge is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz across 8 physical cores and 16 dedicated vCPUs with hyperthreading. The server incorporates 62.0 GB of memory (3.88 GB per core), 48 MB L3 cache, and AVX-512 instruction support. Graphics acceleration and parallel compute capabilities are supplied by a fractional 0.3333 NVIDIA A10 GPU instance providing 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 5 Gbps, while local disk storage is omitted.

In performance evaluations, this instance demonstrates consistent mid-tier results across standard CPU and memory benchmarks. Multi-core performance reaches 28,616.81 in stress-ng tests and a Geekbench multi-core score of 12,885. Uncached memory read bandwidth measures 92.11 GB/sec for large blocks, while write bandwidth reaches 28.19 GB/sec. For AI inference tasks on a small 135M parameter LLM, text generation averages 258.41 tokens per second, dropping to 10.13 tokens per second when evaluating a 7B model.

The primary tradeoff of this instance is the reliance on external network-attached block storage due to the absence of local drives. However, the partitioned A10 GPU configuration provides qualitative cost efficiency for virtual workstation environments and entry-level model execution without requiring a full dedicated GPU accelerator. It is suited for virtual graphics desktops, light 3D computer-aided design, entry-level AI model inference, and general web applications.
